Talent0_2Ability.name: Stay Lit!
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When executing a single-target repair skill, if the target's AP is <color=#F74848>3</color> or less, it gains <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Stay Lit!
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
When executing a single-target repair skill, if the target's AP is <color=#F74848>3</color> or less, it gains <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.
When your HP is above <color=#F74848>50%</color>, Repair Code range is <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

500001.name: CEC 1
500001.SpecificEffects: In cooperation with allies, launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> against the target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

500205.name: Special Care
500205.SpecificEffects: When executing a single-target repair skill, Repair AMT <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, and additionally repairs <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part.

500603.name: Full-Throttle
500603.describe: Restores HP equal to <color=#F74848>2.3x</color> Manipulator Repair AMT to all parts of a single ST. Can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part. Also, applies <buf ID=5006031>[Limit Relief]</buf>, which can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time.

500604.name: Bi-Directional Repair
500604.SpecificEffects: After executing a single-target repair skill, restores HP equal to <color=#F74848>0.4x</color> Manipulator Repair AMT to all parts. Can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part.

500605.name: Intensive Care
500605.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, grants <buf ID=5006052>[Immune to Repair Inhibition]</buf> to the target, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

500606.name: Repair Grid
500606.describe: Restores HP equal to <color=#F74848>1.1x</color> Manipulator Repair AMT to all parts of allies within the selected <range type=1>2-tile diamond area</range>. Can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part. Also, grants <buf ID=7100701>[Defensive Stance I]</buf>, which can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time.

500607.name: Prewar Preparation
500607.SpecificEffects: At start of action, restores HP equal to <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> Manipulator Repair AMT to all parts of an ally with the lowest HP percentage within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles. Can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part.

500608.name: Tactical Reset
500608.describe: Restores HP equal to <color=#F74848>2.0x</color> Manipulator Repair AMT to all parts of a single ST. Can repair <color=#F74848>2</color> destroyed parts. Allows allies who have already taken action to act again.

500609.name: Regulated Repair
500609.describe: Restores HP equal to <color=#F74848>2.0x</color> Manipulator Repair AMT to all parts of a single ST. Can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part.

500011.name: CEC 2
500011.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

500012.name: Part Maintenance 1
500012.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, dispel <color=#F74848>1</color> debuff.

500021.name: CEC 3
500021.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.3</color>.

500031.name: Emergency Repair 1
500031.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, randomly select a single adjacent (<color=#F74848>1</color> tile) ally to perform <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf>. The repair amount is <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT and cannot repair damaged parts.

500033.name: Flexible Repair
500033.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, an additional <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

500034.name: Emergency Repair 2
500034.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf> selects targets within the adjacent (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) area.

500035.name: Emergency Repair 3
500035.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf>'s Repair AMT is now <color=#F74848>1x</color> that of the Manipulator.

500036.name: Emergency Repair 4
500036.SpecificEffects: The number of targets that <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf> can repair increases by <color=#F74848>1</color>.

500641.name: Pumped 1
500641.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900071>[Stay Lit!]</buf> also works on targets with AP <color=#F74848>≤3</color>.

500043.name: Part Maintenance 3
500043.SpecificEffects: Each turn, the AP Cost of the 1st repair skill decreases by <color=#F74848>1</color>, with a minimum cost of <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

500644.name: Pumped 2
500644.SpecificEffects: When executing a single-target repair skill, increases the target's AP Cap by <color=#F74848>1</color>. This effect is independent and does not accumulate.

500645.name: Pumped 3
500645.SpecificEffects: When triggering <buf ID=900071>[Stay Lit!]</buf>, dispels <color=#F74848>1</color> additional debuff from the target.

500646.name: Pumped 4
500646.SpecificEffects: When executing an individual repair skill, increases <buf ID=900078>[Turns Left]</buf> of each buff on the target by <color=#F74848>1</color>.
